description: This file defines an abstract base class for image toolkit operation plugins in Drupal, including constructor logic, argument preparation, validation, and abstract methods for execution.

classes.name: ImageToolkitOperationBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for image toolkit operation plugins, including constructor, argument handling, and abstract execute method.

methods.name: setToolkit
methods.description: Sets the image toolkit instance for this operation.

methods.name: getToolkit
methods.description: Returns the current image toolkit instance.

methods.name: arguments
methods.description: Abstract method to define operation arguments.

methods.name: prepareArguments
methods.description: Prepares and validates arguments, adding defaults for optional ones.

methods.name: validateArguments
methods.description: Validates and corrects arguments, can be overridden for custom validation.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Final method that prepares, validates, and executes the operation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Abstract method to perform the actual image operation.
